subject: general
question: The Mauryan pillar capital found at ________ is popularly known as the Lion Capital.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarnath**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mauryan Pillar Capital found at Sarnath is popularly known as Lion Capital.__
 
• It is one of the finest examples of Mauryan sculpture.
 
• Lion Capital is located at Sarnath, near Varanasi.
 
• It was built in 250 BCE.
 
• It is made up of polished sandstone. The surface is highly polished.
 
• Originally the Capital has 5 components

 
• ​The shaft (now broken into many parts)
 
• A lotus baseball
 
• A drum on the base bell with 4 animals processing clockwise.
 
• Figures of 4 lions
 
• The crowning part, a large wheel (this is also broken)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The Lion Capital is the National Emblem of India.
 
• The inscription Satyamev Jayate is taken from the Mundaka Upanishad.
 
• Gautam Buddha gave his first sermon at Sarnath.
